title: OpenInference structured LLM spans with redacted inputs/outputs: model, provider, span type and token usage come from span attributes, not the payloads
answers: Model badge and provider disappear for a TypeSafe trace when inputs and outputs are redacted
Token usage shows wrong or missing values when output tokens are zero on an OpenInference LLM span
Why does a structured TypeSafe answer payload still show the model when the payload is hidden?
body:
Path: mlflow/tracing/otel/translation/open_inference.py:OpenInferenceTranslator, reached through translate_span_when_storing, handles OpenInference LLM spans whose input.value and output.value are structured payloads (for example TypeSafe questions and answers) or redacted to "__REDACTED__".
Rule: derive the stored model (SpanAttributeKey.MODEL), provider (llm.provider), span type (openinference.span.kind LLM) and chat usage (llm.token_count.prompt/completion/total) from span attributes, not from the inputs or outputs body. Keep a completion count of 0 as OUTPUT_TOKENS 0 rather than dropping it. Do not set MESSAGE_FORMAT for these non-chat structured payloads.
Symptom: when inputs and outputs were hidden, the normalized model name was lost from the trace UI.
Constraints: the redacted and structured cases were verified by tests only in the diff; the translator behavior itself comes from the model-name key list change. Does not apply to chat-message payloads that go through the message-format path.
applies: OpenInference LLM spans with structured or redacted input/output payloads in trace storage.
says: Redacting input and output payloads causes the model and provider tags to disappear.
Token usage shows missing data in the trace view when completion tokens are zero.
Trace spans with masked payloads should still display the model name and token metrics.
Hiding prompt content removes provider information from the span details header.
search: When handling OpenInference LLM spans with structured or redacted payloads in mlflow/tracing/otel/translation/open_inference.py:OpenInferenceTranslator, model, provider, span kind, and token usage are derived from span attributes rather than payload bodies. An output token count of zero is preserved as OUTPUT_TOKENS 0 rather than dropped, and MESSAGE_FORMAT is omitted for non-chat structured payloads. This applies to spans with structured or redacted input.value and output.value attributes, but excludes chat-message payloads.
